guideUi.stagesTitle: How we work — the production stages

guides.headline: Stories shot like cinema, built to sell.
intro: Cinematic production is the heart of Metropolitan Digital Marketing. From our base in Dubai we write, direct, film and edit short films, long films, brand documentaries, commercials and TV advertisements with the same discipline as a film set: a clear story, a trained crew, cinema cameras and a finish that holds up on a television screen as well as on a phone.

Every project starts from your own inputs — your story, your values, your audience — and ends as a film that you can run on television, in cinemas, on websites and on social platforms, in Arabic, English and any of the languages of our site.

services.title: Short and long films
services.text: Narrative and brand films from a few minutes to feature length, written, cast, shot and edited by one team.

services.title: Commercials
services.text: Fast, memorable adverts for digital and social platforms, with cut-downs of 6, 15 and 30 seconds from the same shoot.

services.title: TV advertisements
services.text: Broadcast-standard spots prepared to channel specifications: format, loudness, subtitles and legal clearance.

services.title: Corporate and documentary films
services.text: Company stories, founder interviews and behind-the-scenes documentaries that build credibility.

services.title: Music-style brand films
services.text: Rhythm-driven edits with original or licensed music for launches, events and campaigns.

stages: We study the brand, the audience, the market and the goal of the film, and agree the message and the budget.
A script or treatment is written from your inputs, followed by a storyboard and a shot list for your approval.
Locations, cast, crew, equipment, permits and schedule are prepared and confirmed before the first shooting day.
Filming with a director, cinematographer and crew on cinema cameras, lenses, gimbals, drones and professional lighting.
Editing, colour grading, sound design, music, visual effects and subtitles, with revision rounds included.
Final masters for TV, cinema, web and social, plus cut-downs and a publishing plan.
guides.tools: Cinema cameras · Adobe Premiere Pro · After Effects · DaVinci Resolve · Pro Tools · drones and gimbals

guides.headline: Every curve, every reflection, in motion.
intro: A car is sold by emotion before it is sold by specification. We film and render vehicles so that the paint, the lines and the sound make the viewer want to sit inside: showroom films, launch films, rolling shots on the road, studio reveals and fully computer-generated cars when the real one does not exist yet.

We work with dealerships, brands, car-rental and luxury-car companies, and collectors in Dubai and across the Gulf, and we deliver both the film and the social content that keeps the vehicle in front of buyers.

services.title: Showroom and launch films
services.text: Cinematic reveals with controlled lighting, slow motion and detail macros for new models and limited editions.

services.title: Rolling and tracking shots
services.text: Road and desert sequences shot from camera cars, drones and gimbals with safe, permitted logistics.

services.title: 3D / CGI cars
services.text: Photoreal digital vehicles for configurators, concept reveals and impossible camera moves.

services.title: Dealership social content
services.text: Reels, stories and walk-around videos for each car in stock, published consistently.

services.title: Page management
services.text: Management of dealership and brand pages: calendar, publishing, replies and monthly reports.

stages: We study the model, the buyer profile, the competitors and the story the vehicle should tell.
Concept, mood references, shot list and — when needed — a script for the voice-over or on-screen titles.
Choosing the location or studio, permits, drivers, lighting and camera-car planning, and the filming schedule.
Filming with cinema cameras, rigs, drones and macro lenses; CGI vehicles are modelled and rendered in parallel.
Editing, colour grading, sound design with engine audio, motion graphics and finishing.
Delivery in every format for the website, showroom screens and social platforms, with a posting plan.
guides.tools: Cinema cameras · camera cars and gimbals · drones · 3ds Max · Blender · Adobe Premiere Pro · After Effects

guides.headline: Trust, told with care and accuracy.
intro: Patients choose a hospital, a clinic or a doctor on trust. We create medical and healthcare content that is accurate, respectful and human: films that present a hospital and its departments, interviews with doctors, department heads and directors, podcasts, and professional medical, scientific and cultural videos that educate without exaggeration.
We follow the advertising rules of the health authorities in the UAE, protect patient privacy, and work with your medical team to check every claim before publication.

services.title: Interviews with doctors and directors
services.text: Filmed conversations with physicians, heads of departments and hospital directors, edited into clear and trustworthy videos.

services.title: Podcasts
services.text: Video and audio podcast episodes on health topics, recorded in a professional studio setup and cut for every platform.

services.title: Medical, scientific and cultural videos
services.text: Educational films, awareness campaigns and explainer videos supported by 3D medical animation.

services.title: Hospital and clinic films
services.text: Facility tours, technology showcases, patient-journey films and recruitment videos.

services.title: Page management
services.text: Management of hospital, clinic and doctor pages: compliant content calendar, publishing, replies and monthly reports.

stages: We study the institution, its departments, its audience and the regulations that apply to its communication.
Interview questions, scripts and topics are prepared with your medical team and approved before filming.
Scheduling doctors, preparing the set, sound and lighting, and obtaining consent and permissions.
Filming interviews, procedures and facilities with discreet crews and broadcast-quality sound.
Editing, subtitles in several languages, 3D medical animation, graphics and compliance review.
Delivery in all formats and a publishing plan for your pages, with performance reports.
guides.tools: Interview and podcast kits · Adobe Premiere Pro · After Effects · 3ds Max · Blender · subtitling tools

guides.headline: If it can be imagined, it can be rendered.
intro: 3D animation and CGI let us show what cannot be filmed: a building before it is built, a product exploded into its parts, a character that does not exist, a world that never was. We model, texture, light, animate and render in a full professional pipeline and finish the result like a film.
Our artists work mainly in 3ds Max and Blender, with a proven workflow from first sketch to final frame, for products, architecture, medical visualisation, advertising and entertainment.

services.title: Product animation
services.text: Photoreal product films and exploded views for launches, packaging and online stores.

services.title: Architectural visualisation
services.text: 3D stills and animated films of buildings, interiors and master plans.

services.title: Character and motion graphics
services.text: Characters, mascots, logos in motion and animated explainer videos.

services.title: Visual effects
services.text: Compositing of CGI into real footage: set extensions, simulations, particles and screen replacement.

services.title: 3D medical and technical animation
services.text: Clear animated explanations of procedures, machines and processes.

stages: We collect references, drawings, product files and the goal of the animation, and define the style.
Storyboard, animatic and technical plan: camera moves, duration, resolution and render budget.
Modelling in 3ds Max, then UV mapping, texturing and material creation; rigging when characters are involved.
Lighting, animation and rendering with a render farm for high resolution and long sequences.
Compositing, effects, colour grading, sound design and music, with revision rounds.
Delivery in 2K, 4K or custom formats, with project files on request.
guides.tools: 3ds Max · Blender · V-Ray · Corona · Substance Painter · After Effects · Adobe Premiere Pro

guides.headline: Artificial intelligence, directed by humans.
intro: AI creative is not a shortcut; it is a new studio. We use the best image, video, voice and language models, guided by experienced directors, to produce concepts, adverts and films faster and at a scale that was not affordable before — while keeping a human eye on quality, brand fit and rights.
Beyond content, we build the AI systems that work for your company: websites built with AI, AI agents, specialised chatbots with CRM, WhatsApp automations and complete custom systems.

services.title: AI product and fashion visuals

services.title: Websites and systems with AI

Delivery of final files, or deployment and training for your team when the output is a system.

guides.headline: Properties that sell before the first visit.
intro: In real estate, the first impression happens on a screen. We produce films, 3D visuals and social content that let buyers and investors walk through a property from anywhere in the world, and we manage your real-estate and interior-design pages so that the story continues after the video ends.

Whether you are a developer launching a tower, a broker with one apartment or a company selling off-plan units, we plan the content as a campaign: filming the whole apartment room by room, creative montage with music and motion, 3D animation for projects still under construction, advertising, and podcasts that position you as the expert.

services.title: Full-property filming
services.text: We film the entire apartment or villa — every room, balcony, view and detail — with stabilised cinema cameras and natural light.

services.title: Creative montage
services.text: Professional editing with rhythm, transitions, music, titles and colour grading: a short film instead of a simple walkthrough.

services.title: 3D animation for off-plan projects
services.text: Buildings, lobbies and units modelled in 3ds Max and animated for projects not yet built.

services.title: Real-estate and interior-design page management
services.text: Publishing, listing highlights, reels, stories, replies and monthly reports on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

services.title: Ads and podcasts
services.text: Paid-ad creatives for Meta, Google and TikTok, and podcast episodes with brokers, developers and designers.

stages: We study the property, the neighbourhood, the buyer or investor profile and the sales goal.
Concept and script from your inputs, a shot list for each room, and the platform plan for the final cuts.
Access to the property, staging advice, lighting plan, drone permits and filming schedule.
Filming every room and the exterior, plus 3D renders and animation for what is not built yet.
Creative editing, colour, music, titles in several languages and vertical versions for reels.
Delivery, publishing on your pages and monthly reporting on views and enquiries.

guides.headline: Where design becomes a story worth showing.
intro: Interior design is a visual craft, and it deserves to be presented as one. At Metropolitan Digital Marketing in Dubai we create content for interior designers, fit-out contractors and construction firms: we turn drawings, moodboards and finished spaces into images, films and 3D worlds that let a client feel the space before it exists and remember it after it is built.

We build complete 3D scenes of interiors and exteriors, film projects realistically during execution and after handover, and craft animated videos and walkthroughs that guide the viewer room by room — lighting, materials, furniture and atmosphere included. Every project is planned like a film: a study, a story, a shooting plan and a careful edit.

Behind the screen is the professional toolchain of the industry: AutoCAD for plans and engineering drawings, 3ds Max and Blender for modelling, lighting and rendering, Adobe Premiere Pro and other editing software for the final film, and the engineering programs your consultants already use. We work from your files instead of asking you to start again.

guides.headline: Make guests feel the stay before they book it.
intro: Hotels, resorts and restaurants sell an experience. We capture it in films and images that show the light in the lobby, the view from the room, the taste of the table and the rhythm of the service, so that a guest in another country can feel the stay before booking it.
We create content for hotels, resorts, restaurants, cafés and event venues in Dubai and across the Gulf, and we manage their pages so that the experience is shown every day, not only at launch.

We work with fragrance houses, cosmetics brands, salons and clinics to create campaign films, product visuals and social content with the elegance of the category.
